tldr: The sole headline remains the open full unequal-index minimax MSE map for a fixed-dose causal mean when the conditional dose density has a covariate-common polynomial point zero and the covariate density is unknown and merely bounded.  The proved same-class spine gives the oracle floor, the balanced fuzzy lower term under its stated calibration premise, and a fully observed split-cell upper map: oracle order for \(s=\beta+\gamma_x>d/2\), a logarithmic boundary rate for \(s=d/2\), and the explicit loose rate \((\log n/n)^{2\alpha s/(\alpha d+sv)}\) for \(s<d/2\).  The remaining headline gap is a matching unequal-index converse and an observed-data construction beyond empirical-Gram rank.
gap: Degenerate-design theory gives a scalar pointwise rate, and higher-order dose-response theory treats positive local treatment density or controllable projection geometry; neither gives the unequal-index same-class frontier under an exact common point zero and merely bounded unknown \(p_X\).
